# Stress and Strategies to Promote Well Being

Welcome to *NURS 180: Stress and Strategies to Promote Well Being*.

This online book introduces foundational concepts and practical strategies for understanding stress, strengthening resilience, and promoting physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual well-being.

## About this book

The book follows the course topics outlined in the NURS 180 syllabus. It explores the experience of stress in university life and the ways students can develop healthy approaches to managing stress and supporting their well-being.

## What you will learn

By working through this book, you will explore:

- Stress, stressors, and resilience.
- The domains of self-care and the importance of social support.
- The physiological and psychological effects of stress.
- The relationships between stress, sleep, physical activity, and nutrition.
- Mental health, diversity, and social justice.
- Time and resource management.
- Cognitive restructuring and reframing.
- Spirituality, nature, and creative expression.
- Strategies for developing a personal stress management plan.

## How to use this book

Read each chapter alongside the assigned course readings and learning activities. Use the reflection questions to connect concepts with your own experiences and identify strategies that may support your well-being.

This book is a learning resource and does not replace professional mental health care when it is needed.
